svg.title: All 15 pairs of [-4, -1, 2, 3, 5, 8] and the step that decided each
svg.desc: Row i, column j, for i < j. Row 0 columns 1 to 4 counted at step 2; row 1 columns 2 and 3 counted at step 4. Column 5 ruled out at step 1, column 4 rows 1 to 3 at step 3, cell (2,3) at step 5. Six cells counted.
svg.text: every pair (i, j), i < j: which step decided it
6 cells counted: rows are + steps, columns are × steps
